title: Aikatsu Stars 10th Anniversary Film's Trailer Unveils Theme Song, January 22 Debut
content: Bandai Namco Pictures presented the full trailer and a key visual for Aikatsu Stars! Hoshiboshi no Progress (The Progress of the Stars), the film celebrating the 10th anniversary of the Aikatsu Stars! anime, during a fan meeting event for the film on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: Stranger Than Heaven Game Streams Story Trailer for 1st Act 'Kokura'
content: Sega began streaming a story trailer for Ryu ga Gotoku Studio's Stranger Than Heaven game (previously codenamed "Project Century") on Friday. The video outlines the game's first act "Kokura," and "depicts the events that led Daito, who had endured persecution in America, to stow away on the 'ghost ship' of the…
author: ANN

title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Calamity Anime Streams 'Last' Promo Video
content: The official YouTube channel for the Bleach franchise began streaming on Friday "the last" promotional video for Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Calamity , the fourth and final part of the Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War anime.
author: ANN

title: OceanVeil to Add 19 Anime Titles from Media Blasters
content: Streaming platform OceanVeil announced on Thursday that it is partnering with Media Blasters to add 19 anime to its service over the coming weeks. Some titles will also include the anime's English dub.
author: ANN

title: Comikey Adds Mato Kauta's The Wolf King's Bride Manga
content: Comikey announced on Friday it has licensed Mato Kauta 's The Wolf King’s Bride ( Ōkami-Heika no Hanayome ) manga. The company released the first five chapters digitally, and will add new chapters every Friday.
author: ANN

title: Peow2 Licenses Jyoshikohei, Alien 9, Phantom Core Manga
content: Sweden-based comic publisher Peow2 announced on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday it has licensed three new manga for English release: Jiro Matsumoto 's Jyoshikohei , Hitoshi Tomizawa 's Alien 9 , and Yasushi Nirasawa 's Phantom Core . ‼️INCOMING LICENSE💥 Jyoshikohei by Jiro Matsumoto .
author: ANN

title: 3 Fantasy Webtoon That Should Get Anime Instead of The Remarried Empress
content: The webtoon industry is on the rise thanks to several anime adaptations, and Crunchyroll has played a huge role in giving these anime a global platform. One of the biggest projects is The Remarried Empress , a controversial romance fantasy.
author: ComicBook

title: Viz Media Licenses Jojolion, His Sweet Solace, Under Doctor, More Manga for Summer 2027
content: Viz Media revealed on its X (formerly Twitter ) account on Friday its slate of works it will release in summer 2027: Viz Media will release a complete box set collection of Julietta Suzuki 's Kamisama Kiss manga with 25 volumes. The collection will include a double-sided poster and a mini artbook.
author: ANN

title: Haikyu Creator Returns With New Look at Shoyo Ahead of New Movie
content: While fans await the upcoming anime movie, Haruichi Furudate drops a new look at Shoyo Hinata to commemorate the first Haruko collaboration since 2020. The series is Japan’s Spring High Volleyball tournament for the first time in seven years.
author: ComicBook

title: 3 Spooky Anime to Watch on Crunchyroll This October
content: The fall 2026 season is here, and with October also comes the spooky season, with Halloween arriving at the end of the month. While there are many ways to celebrate, the anime industry also has plenty to offer, and Crunchyroll is the right place to start. There are dozens of anime that fit this month’s theme.
author: ComicBook
